entries.label: c01_school_03
entries.text: This is the famous, torturously long staircase of\nthe academy! Not an easy climb, is it?

entries.label: c01_school_05
entries.text: Mesagoza is like a full table—it’s got the school,\nit’s got culture, it’s got everything!

entries.label: c01_school_09
entries.text: There are lots of different people and Pokémon\nat the school—and you’re part of the variety!

entries.label: c01_school_16
entries.text: Those Team Star kids are a little scary, don’t\nyou think?

entries.label: c01_school_17
entries.text: I hear that Team Star races around every night,\nriding on weird cars of some kind.

entries.label: c01_northwest_06
entries.text: You get to choose which classes you want to take\nat the academy, right? Schools are so different\r\nfrom when I was a student...

entries.label: c01_northwest_10
entries.text: Hello? Yes, the students here are just the best.\nA huge help to everyone, really!

entries.label: c01_northwest_16
entries.text: They don’t call it the biggest city in Paldea for\nnothing! I’ve gotten myself completely lost!

entries.label: c01_northwest_17
entries.text: The green arrow in your map app points north!\nTo lock your map’s orientation so that north’s\r\nalways at the top, press the Right Stick!

entries.label: c01_northwest_27
entries.text: The Pokémon League’s through that tunnel, right?\c\nThat’s where you get tested to see if you can\nbecome a Champion!

entries.label: c01_northwest_28
entries.text: I just had my interview at the Pokémon League!\nThe interviewer was real scary, though...

entries.label: c01_northwest_32
entries.text: Outside the city, you’ll run into tons of Pokémon\nthat you’ve never seen before!

entries.label: c01_northwest_40
entries.text: You know Tulip the supermodel, right? Well,\napparently she’s a childhood friend of one of\r\nthe teachers at the academy!

entries.label: c01_park_01
entries.text:
There are tons of hills and cliffs up ahead. Be
careful not to get lost, OK?\c
Once you get through, you’ll reach Artazon, the
town of nature and art!

entries.label: c01_park_07
entries.text: A famous professor unraveled the secrets of the\nTerastal phenomenon.

entries.label: c01_park_08
entries.text: I hear the professor’s doing some amazing\nresearch at the Great Crater of Paldea...

entries.label: c01_park_10
entries.text: Each night’s sleep brings you one day closer to\nschool! So make sure to get lots of sleep!

entries.label: c01_park_11
entries.text: I wanna go to the big school too!

entries.label: c01_park_16
entries.text: Time passes, weather changes...\c\nI hear wild Pokémon behave differently too,\ndepending on the weather and time of day.

entries.label: c01_park_20
entries.text: This pond is huge!\c\nI wanna float around in it just like a Magikarp!

entries.label: c01_park_25
entries.text:
I feel like school teachers always get weird
nicknames from their students.\c
I keep hearing kids mentioning names like
“Old Hass” and “Brovatore.”

entries.label: c01_park_29
entries.text: Some Pokémon can’t learn certain moves!

entries.label: c01_park_38
entries.text: I wanted to get a Tera Orb of my very own but\nmy grades weren’t quite good enough...

entries.label: c01_park_39
entries.text: You have to be a good student to get a Tera Orb.\nThey’re too powerful to be given out willy-nilly.

entries.label: c01_center_south_01
entries.text: This is Mesagoza, the biggest city in Paldea!

entries.label: c01_center_south_15
entries.text: Sagu’s home ec is a really useful class to take!

entries.label: c01_center_south_16
entries.text: Ms. Rai’s history classes are so much fun!

entries.label: c01_center_south_31
entries.text: Now, which sandwich shop should we eat\nat today?

entries.label: c01_center_south_32
entries.text: Shops in the same chain still have slightly\ndifferent menus depending on their location!

entries.label: c01_center_south_44
entries.text: The Pokémon you see around town are usually\nsomebody’s partner. It’s best you don’t try to\r\ncatch them!

entries.label: c01_center_south_93
entries.text: My Pokémon’s really sensitive to sounds!

entries.label: c01_center_south_94
entries.text: Pokémon of the same species can still have\ndifferent strengths, natures, and even Abilities.

entries.label: c01_center_south_100
entries.text: Rain in Paldea isn’t that cold and it stops really\nquickly, so nobody here uses an umbrella.

entries.label: c01_center_north_33
entries.text: My son told me he’d joined some group called\nTeam Star. I have no idea what kind of sports\r\nteam that is, but I’m sure it’s very fun!

entries.label: c01_center_north_40
entries.text:
Look at this battle court right here in the
central plaza!\c
It takes a lot of courage to battle here, since
there’s always going to be quite an audience!

entries.label: c01_center_north_41
entries.text:
I heard that other regions only have one
Champion!\c
It’s really cool that Paldea has so many
Champion-ranked Trainers, don’t you think?

entries.label: c01_center_north_54
entries.text: I’m not a huge fan of shopping online... Nothing\nbeats being able to see the product firsthand.

entries.label: c01_center_north_82
entries.text: Did you know? You can have up to six Pokémon\non your team!

entries.label: c01_center_north_83
entries.text: Any Pokémon beyond the six on your team get\nsent to your Boxes, right?

entries.label: c01_center_north_91
entries.text: If I gather up the materials dropped by Pokémon\nand trade them in for LP, I can buy what I want...\r\neven if I don’t have any money!

entries.label: c01_center_north_94
entries.text: Mesagooozaaa, the city of leeeaaarning! ♪\nI studied at the school, my passion buuurning! ♪

entries.label: c01_stairs_03
entries.text: The entrance hall of the school is full of books,\nand you’re free to read as many as you’d like.\r\nIt’s a great place for any bookworm!

entries.label: c01_stairs_08
entries.text: I’m a graduate of the academy, you know!\nI wonder if they still do that Treasure Hunt thing.

entries.label: c01_stairs_22
entries.text: The academy doesn’t have any age restrictions—\neven my grandma could enroll! Maybe this is a\r\ngood chance to redo my own studies!

entries.label: c01_square_01
entries.text: The west gate is this way! Head out from there if\nyou want to go to Cortondo!

entries.label: c01_square_02
entries.text: The west gate is down the other path—the one\npast the canned goods store!

entries.label: c01_square_03
entries.text: This way’s a dead end! All you’ll find down there\nis the Go-for-Broke Grill!

entries.label: c01_square_14
entries.text: I better get ready for the Treasure Hunt.\nNow where was Delibird Presents...?

entries.label: c01_square_15
entries.text: There are a few Delibird Presents in this city.\nYou’ll run into one if you just head south.

entries.label: c01_square_16
entries.text: It’s such a relief when there’s a Pokémon Center\nnearby. I like the music they play, too.

entries.label: c01_square_17
entries.text: You can use a Flying Taxi to get back to any\nPokémon Center you’ve been to before!

entries.label: c01_southeast_04
entries.text: So what’s the difference between a town and a\ncity anyway? Is it the size...?

entries.label: c01_southeast_05
entries.text: There are three big cities here in Paldea! One of\nthem is where we are now—Mesagoza!

entries.label: c01_southeast_08
entries.text: I heard there were unusual sandwiches being sold\naround here, but...where?

entries.label: c01_southeast_17
entries.text: Sandwiches are so good! I wanna have one\nevery day!

entries.label: c01_southeast_18
entries.text: Hee hee! Do you want to try making sandwiches\ntogether sometime?

entries.label: c01_southeast_27
entries.text: The north side of the city is mostly residential.\c\nSeems they don’t let you live in the student dorm\nif you’re from Mesagoza. Makes sense, really.

entries.label: c01_southeast_40
entries.text: It makes me so happy just to see someone\nwalking around with their Pokémon.

entries.label: c01_southeast_43
entries.text: I love sandwiches! But this store’s sandwiches are\na particular favorite!

entries.label: c01_southeast_45
entries.text: If you get a smartphone case at Delibird Presents,\nyou can change how your Rotom Phone looks!\r\nSo many choices... Which one should I go for?

entries.label: c01_southwest_06
entries.text: Once I catch my own Pokémon, I’m gonna\nbecome a Champion-ranked Trainer!

entries.label: c01_southwest_12
entries.text: Are star-shaped shades popular at the school?\nI saw a group of students all wearing them.

entries.label: c01_southwest_19
entries.text: Each town’s battle court has a different color\nand look to it, you know?

entries.label: c01_southwest_23
entries.text: That nice lady at the Pokémon Center always\ngives me little tips when my Pokémon get healed.\r\nIs it just me? D’you think she likes me?!

entries.label: c01_southwest_29
entries.text:
I’m having my Pachirisu hold an item I bought at
Delibird Presents!\c
Pokémon can get all sorts of perks from the item
they hold, you know?

entries.label: c01_southwest_31
entries.text: Good things can happen from time to time if you\nlet your Pokémon hold a Quick Claw!\c\nThey have ’em for sale there at the red shop!

entries.label: c01_southwest_36
entries.text: You can reach Cortondo if you head out the west\ngate and just keep going. They have their harvest\r\nfestival around this time of year.

entries.label: c01_southwest_53
entries.text: Bronzong is so soothing...\c\nIt lets me get inside it from time to time. It’s the\nmost calming, peaceful experience...

entries.label: c01_southwest_60
entries.text: Well, I’m completely lost. Time to boot up the\nold map app.

entries.label: c01_southwest_61
entries.text: Some meals here will fill you with Egg Power!\c\nThat’ll make it easier for you to find Pokémon\nEggs when you’re out on a picnic!

entries.label: c01_northeast_04
entries.text: You can exchange materials dropped by\nPokémon for LP at the TM Machine!

entries.label: c01_northeast_08
entries.text: Machines these days are so talkative! Even the\nTM Machine’s real chatty, don’t you think?

entries.label: c01_northeast_09
entries.text: Pachirisu’s Ability is Run Away! It’s real good at\ngetting away from wild Pokémon!

entries.label: c01_northeast_23
entries.text: Huh. Vending machines these days let you buy a\ndrink with LP too, eh?

entries.label: c01_northeast_24
entries.text: The staircase in front of the school is famous for\nbeing torturously long. I certainly don’t envy the\r\nstudents who have to climb it regularly!

entries.label: c01_northeast_37
entries.text: If you come across a sleeping wild Pokémon,\nthat’s a great chance to get the drop on it!

entries.label: c01_northeast_38
entries.text: Whenever I see sleeping Pokémon, I can’t stop\nsnapping photos of them!

entries.label: c01_northeast_47
entries.text: What was the new director’s name...Mr. Clavell?\nHe became director about a year and a half ago.

entries.label: c01_northeast_54
entries.text: Do you know Nemona, the student council\npresident? She’s such a sweet young lady.\r\nShe always says hi when she passes by!

entries.label: c01_northeast_71
entries.text: If you come across a beautiful view, don’t forget\nto snap a picture with the camera app.

entries.label: c01_other_01_01
entries.text: Are you also the type that likes to chill out on\nrooftops? Well, make sure you don’t fall off.

entries.label: c01_center_north_99
entries.text: You can buy academy-approved bags in various\ncolors at this shop!\c\nNow, which color should I choose...?

entries.label: c01_center_north_100
entries.text: I need to get my hair styled at Salon Renacer.\nCould you kill some time around here?

entries.label: c01_center_north_101
entries.text: Side part, romantic tuck...\c\nThey have some hair styles that almost sound like\nPokémon moves!

entries.label: c01_center_north_102
entries.text: Maybe I’ll buy some glasses at the Spec Shack\nand get a new, bespectacled look!

entries.label: c01_center_north_103
entries.text: I want to wear a stylish hat! But I also want\npeople to notice my hair!\c\n...Guess I’ll make up my mind inside the shop.

entries.label: c01_center_north_104
entries.text: If you get cold feet easily, you need some nice,\nthick socks—and this shop has a great selection!

entries.label: c01_square_28
entries.text: They’ve got fruit, vegetables, and even rice!\c\nSure Cans is where to go if you want to buy a ton\nof food and make heaps of sandwiches!
